concerns.text: Success Criterion SC‑001 (baseline mean‑only model improvement) has no dedicated task; the plan lacks a step that trains/evaluates a baseline model and records the R²/RMSE comparison required to demonstrate ≥ 0.05 R² (or ≥ 10 % RMSE) gain.

Success Criterion SC‑003 (pipeline must complete within 6 h on the free‑tier runner) is not covered by any task that records wall‑clock time and peak RSS (e.g., a `runtime_log.json` artifact). Without such a task the runtime limit cannot be verified.

Success Criterion SC‑007 (data‑ingestion validation pass‑rate ≥ 95 % over three runs) is not addressed by any task; the plan does not include a repeatability test or a metric‑collection step to compute the empirical pass‑rate.

Principle II (Verified Accuracy) of the constitution requires a citation‑validation step, but the plan contains no task that runs the Reference‑Validator Agent or otherwise verifies external citations.
